name: cortex
description: Relative Cortex orchestration for reliable staged agent work with durable internal audit state.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate staged work across Codex agents
interface.longDescription: Adds 21 bundled agent profiles, 10 skills, three coordinator lifecycle operations, and scoped worker report transport over the local Cortex v7 ledger. Coordinators own and adapt the pipeline, workers persist compactly referenced reports, and Cortex preserves receipt-backed gates, verification, and handoff state.
interface.defaultPrompt: Coordinate this task with Cortex. Use help, harvest, or harvest-refresh when that exact route is requested.
